brand.title: Quiziyyy
welcome.title: Turn Lessons into Epic Team Battles
welcome.subtitle: Engage every student physically and verbally. Divided into teams, discussing together, and answering live on the classroom projector screen.
welcome.feature1Desc: Students work in teams of 4–5 with designated leaders, discussing answers before stepping up to answer verbally.
welcome.feature2Desc: Clean, high-visibility classroom display with live countdown timers, celebratory score updates, and leaderboard standings.
welcome.feature3Desc: Teams unlock and activate cards like 2X Double Points and Shield Defense to climb the scoreboard.
welcome.loopTitle: How the Classroom Game Loop Works
welcome.loopStep1Desc: Teacher starts the question with points and countdown timer.
welcome.loopStep2Desc: Students debate and agree on the answer together.
welcome.loopStep3Desc: Team representative answers in front of class; teacher taps choice.
welcome.loopStep4Desc: Points awarded or deducted live; scores update permanently.

teams.subtitle: Manage classroom teams, leaders, and members
teams.description: Teams of ~4–5 students compete together. One student is designated as leader. Scores persist across all sessions.
